health_probe_semantics.deployment_probe: serving runtime probe records a normal deployment health check
health_probe_semantics.inference_probe: endpoint probe resolves the same runtime revision path used by prediction

traffic_semantics.canary: target revision receives 1-99 percent traffic and a healthy baseline receives the remainder
traffic_semantics.full_promotion: target revision receives 100 percent traffic and active peers drain to 0
traffic_semantics.rollback: target healthy revision receives 100 percent traffic and all active non-target revisions are drained
traffic_semantics.routing: inference selects a servable deployment revision by deterministic request-id weighted routing
